description.value: Stoltz Pool sits on the Cowichan River — a BC and Canadian Heritage River celebrated for wild salmon and steelhead — with a converted rail corridor running alongside that is tailor-made for loaded cyclists; the park is a busy summer recreation corridor, so expect company at peak season.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record identifies this as Stoltz Pool Campground within Cowichan River Park, a BC Parks site with 43 sites, tents and caravans allowed, and drinking water available. The website confirms this is an active provincial park with camping reservations available through camping.bcparks.ca. The park page highlights adjacency to an abandoned rail right-of-way used by cyclists and the Trans Canada Trail trestles, making it directly relevant for touring cyclists. OSM tags indicate internet_access=no and no sanitary dump station. No specific mention of hiker/biker sites, showers, or other amenities in the website content provided.
concerns: Phone number +1-877-559-2115 is for the park operator (K2 Cowichan Park Services Ltd.), not BC Parks general line; website contact page lists 1-800-689-9025 as the BC Parks number but directs campground-specific questions to the operator
Website is the general Cowichan River Park page, not specific to Stoltz Pool Campground; amenity details for this specific campground are not confirmed on the page
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active BC Parks campground on the Cowichan River adjacent to a rail trail and the Trans Canada Trail, directly on a cycling corridor — strong fit for touring cyclists in the Cowichan Valley.
